name: TRUTH App — Protected Table Snapshot to Drive
description: Polls snapshot queue every 10 min. Saves change records from protected tables to Drive as .md files. Guards drift_guards, framework_rules, tensions_wall, kb_sights, kb_conclusions. ASK 228: a file Drive refuses is sent again after 62 s; if refused twice its rows go back to pending and the run errors.

parameters.jsCode:
const built = $('Build Snapshot Content').all().map(x => x.json);
return [{ json: { status: 'snapshot_saved', path: $prevNode.name, tables: built.map(b => b.table_name), files: built.map(b => b.filename), saved: $input.all().length, of: built.length, ts: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'PROTECTED SNAPSHOT: Drive refused ' + $('Collect Unsaved Rows').first().json.files.join(', ') + ' twice, 62 s apart (' + $('Collect Unsaved Rows').first().json.error + '). Re-queued ' + $('Re-queue Unsaved Rows').all().filter(i => i.json && i.json.id).length + ' of ' + $('Collect Unsaved Rows').first().json.ids.length + ' queue rows as pending for the next run.' }}
